name: Maternity Monsters! ~Shinsou no Shinso to Ecchi de Abunai Shinsou Tsuikyuu!~
original_name: またにてぃもんすたぁず！～深窓の真祖とえっちでアブナイ真相追求！～
source:
Monster girls have an almost impossible time becoming pregnant. Only about .2% of the time having sex can one get pregnant. For this end a special school has been created. Here humans and monster girls can attend school together where daily sex is required and open sex is encouraged.

After his marriage to [url=/v9979]Hakua[/url] and then to [url=/v9980]Ooko[/url], Taichi lives every day now in lovey dovey baby making sex with his two wives. Eleonora Vletoblood, nicknamed Nora, an old acquaintance of Ooko transfers to the school. The two immediately glare at one another and Ooko does not wish to get along with the vampire girl. Meanwhile Nora is determined to make Ooko and Hakua's 'boyfriend' her own then throw him away like trash to prove her superiority to the wolf and rabbit girls.
translation:
魔物娘怀孕的概率几乎为零。只有大约0.2%的性行为能导致怀孕。为此建立了一所特殊的学校。在这里人类和魔物娘可以一起上学，每天的性爱是必须的，公开性行为是被鼓励的。

在先后与[url=/v9979]白亚[/url]和[url=/v9980]大子[/url]结婚后，太一每天和两位妻子过着甜蜜的造人生活。大子的旧识艾蕾奥诺拉·维列托布拉德（昵称诺拉）转学到了这所学校。两人一见面就互相瞪视，大子不愿与这个吸血鬼女孩和睦相处。与此同时，诺拉决心要把大子和白亚的“男朋友”据为己有，然后像垃圾一样抛弃他，以证明自己对狼女和兔女的优越感。
